title: Keeplings Gameplay - Created with Fable/Pixellab/Tinyswords asset pack
author: Endlesscrysis
selftext:
I've used fable and pixellab to make a game called keeplings.

It looks a bit like tower defense at first, but you are not placing towers along a path. You build and upgrade units, place them in lanes, manage workers/economy, and send extra pressure at the other side. Then the wave plays out automatically.

If your lane loses, enemies leak through to the Keep, and your surviving units fall back to help the King defend. So the game becomes less about perfect tower placement and more about army composition, economy timing, and surviving bad waves.

The closest genre is probably “lane defense autobattler.” It is inspired by Legion TD2 and the old warcraft 3 mods, but I’m trying to make it its own thing.

Give it a try please, literally just got vps/domain and stuff setup so didn't really have any testing yet besides playing locally against AI or against friends with a cloudflare tunnel.

  
[https://playkeeplings.com/](https://playkeeplings.com/)

comments.author: Larks87
comments.body:
Funny game. Even if it is made with help of AI it just works and feels really good to play and watch the battles. The sprites and animations are also enjoyable to watch. 🙂

What other tools did you use to create the game besides AI? Is it web-based or running on something like Godot/Unity?

replies.author: Endlesscrysis
replies.body: TypeScript for game/client code PixiJS v8 for 2D rendering, sprites, animations, effects, and canvas/WebGL Vite for local dev/build tooling Node.js + ws for the online match relay server Firebase for accounts/sign-in

replies.author: Larks87
replies.body:
Thanks for sharing! 

Keep up the good work!
